test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the time by Rekha's watch, it is quarter past 9 and the hour-hand is pointing to the west. In which of the given directions will the minute-hand point AFTER 75 minutes?
solution:
• According to the time by Rekha's watch, it is quarter past 9 and the hour-hand is pointing to the west.
 
• The hands of the clock at 9.15 will appear as shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c391483147d0e182f067571c802670a2eb49caf43e2da80ecea87a6d9c422e1.png] 

 
• After 75 minutes, the time will be 9.15 + 75 mins = 10.30.
 
• Thus, the hands of the clock will appear as shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92e03140e7dc8aba28459fdcd88994244ed57bf43227560fdb0da0a4ab35b12a.png] 

 
• Now, the minute-hand is pointing towards the South.

​Hence, **"option 4"** is the correct answer.
